title: Suda51’s Grasshopper Manufacture splits from NetEase Games to go independent

The split comes after NetEase Games’ five-year ownership of Grasshopper Manufacture, which was the result of an equity transfer agreement that involved the latter’s former parent company, GungHo Online Entertainment. The studio produced two titles under NetEase Games: 2024’s Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered (a remaster of the 2011 action-adventure game) and 2026’s Romeo is a Dead Man.
